history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

classes-18.description: Every class twice: 18 fresh seeds, 100,000 engine turns, classes dealt and races cycled as in classes-1800. A smoke suite for assigned births.

experiment.description: In the breeders-x4 and breeders-x8 worlds on borg-reborn-rs 201d56eb (PR #892), does the flight Recall blow model (poison priced as HP, status blows by their dice, a breeder's risk never refusing Recall) save the games in which the old rule refused Recall against worm masses, where the normal world changed no outcome in 360 starts? Each world has its own control. Generated from definitions/reborn-recall-blow-worlds-pilot.yaml: 4 arms on 4.2.6-reborn-rust-recall-blow-worlds-201d56eb, suite classes-18.
experiment.name: reborn-recall-blow-worlds-pilot
experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-22: zoo owner, "yes do it" (the breeder-world pilot of #632, the scenario companion #679; RULES 21).
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-22, before any game of this build was played in these worlds (borg-zoo#679, companion of #632; RULES 21). blow-off against blow-on in
breeders-x4 and in breeders-x8 (4 profiles), classes-18, 18 starts each (72 cells), 100,000 turns, evidence retained. A world's arms are compared only
within that world. Gate: no config_error; one binary; every cell records its world with the same borg_world_data_sha256 in every arm of that world; each
arm's value in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls apart; identical plays. Report per world, arm and class:
deaths and causes (breeders and poison apart), CL and DL, paired rescued and newly killed; per arm "# Refusing flight Recall" notes per game (both
reasons) and flight Recall reads, the "# Flight Recall forecast: ... (#880)" notes, deaths during a pending Recall. A breeder world is a stress test; a
lead needs the normal-world result of #632 (no outcome changed in 360 starts) to be read with it. Directional (RULES 14).
experiment.question: In the breeders-x4 and breeders-x8 worlds on borg-reborn-rs 201d56eb (PR #892), does the flight Recall blow model (poison priced as HP, status blows by their dice, a breeder's risk never refusing Recall) save the games in which the old rule refused Recall against worm masses, where the normal world changed no outcome in 360 starts? Each world has its own control.
